title: Open world — free exploration
description: An open voxel world. Trees grow to the southwest, a stone outcrop rises to the northeast, grass fields spread in between. No storm, no deadline, no required outcome — simply a world and a span of time.
goal: You have 60 turns in this world. Do whatever you want — build, explore, gather, shape the terrain, or just observe. There is no success or failure; the session simply ends at turn 60.
notes: Pure observational mode. No win/loss, no behavior grade. get_result returns only position, placed blocks, distance traveled, block types touched, and inventory.
Purpose: reveal each creature's default orientation when no task is imposed — builder vs gatherer vs wanderer vs observer.
